content.short: Kraken provides one of the most trusted cryptocurrency exchanges available in the United States.
content.description: Kraken is a United States–based cryptocurrency exchange and bank, founded in 2011. Users can buy, sell, and hold digital assets and use Kraken's tools and features to grow their portfolio. Developers can use the REST API to connect to public endpoints for programmatic access. Kraken was one of the first bitcoin exchanges to be listed on Bloomberg Terminal and is reportedly valued at $10.8 billion USD as of mid-summer 2022.
